name: Perspective Accurate Splatting via Projective Conic Mapping
definition: A point rendering technique that approximates the projective mapping of Gaussian reconstruction kernels from tangent planes to image space using affine mappings derived from conic isocontours, ensuring perspective accuracy at the kernel cutoff boundary rather than just the center.
summary: Perspective Accurate Splatting via Projective Conic Mapping computes perspective-correct splat shapes by approximating projective mappings with affine mappings derived from conic isocontours, ensuring accuracy at the kernel cutoff boundary to prevent artifacts under extreme perspective projections.
